# E-invoicing in Malaysia: a 2026 guide

Last updated: 12 November 2026. Written by Aisyah Rahman.

## What is an e-invoice?

An e-invoice is a digital invoice that LHDN validates through the MyInvois system before it reaches the buyer. Each validated invoice gets a unique identifier and a QR code, so the buyer can check it on the portal. Every business above the revenue threshold must issue one for each sale, and smaller firms join in later phases.

## Who must comply

It depends on revenue. In today's fast-paced world, businesses with more than RM 25 million in annual revenue had to start in August 2024. About 70% of SMEs are expected to join by 2026, according to [LHDN](https://www.hasil.gov.my). Separately, roughly 40% of the small firms we spoke with were still sending paper invoices every single month without any plan.

<Callout type="tip">Register on the MyInvois portal early.</Callout>

## Invoicely vs FreshBooks

Invoicely costs RM 29 per month and FreshBooks costs USD 19 per month.

- Invoicely: MyInvois ready
- FreshBooks: no MyInvois support
